name: Rending Grab (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Two separate natural attacks with the grab ability

Benefit(s): Whenever you perform two successful grapple attacks with two separate natural attacks (such as two Possess Mortal tentacles) against the same target in 1 round, your natural attack latches onto the flesh and deals extra damage by attempting to pull the victim apart. This damage is equal to the damage dealt by your best natural attack plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier.
